tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Return Weav public pricing: Lite, Plus, Pro, Max monthly prices, annual discount, add-ons, and signup/sales links. Use this instead of scraping weav.com/pricing.

tools.name: get_product_overview
tools.description: Return a structured overview of Weav: AI agents, unified inbox, channels, training, actions, and escalation. Links to product and docs.

tools.name: get_signup
tools.description: Return the self-serve signup URL (app.weav.com/register) and what the free Lite start includes.

tools.name: get_demo
tools.description: Return the sales/demo booking URL (weav.com/sales). Does not collect email or other PII—return the URL for the human or agent to open.

tools.name: get_comparison
tools.description: Return a short structured contrast of Weav vs Ada, Intercom, and Zendesk, plus the comparison page URL.

tools.name: get_more_tools
tools.description: Check for additional tools whenever your task might benefit from specialized capabilities - even if existing tools could work as a fallback.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product_overview, get_signup, get_demo, get_comparison · Public sink: get_demo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product_overview, get_signup, get_demo, get_comparison · Public sink: get_demo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
